text: X509Certificate2.GetRSAPrivateKey() throws 'Keyset does not exist'? That is NTE_BAD_KEYSET from Win32. The cert has a public part; the private key file lives in Crypto\Keys and your process identity cannot read it. Three fixes: grant ACL on the key file, load PFX with MachineKeySet plus PersistKeySet, or use EphemeralKeySet.
